####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: This script produces descriptive statistics and various plots (maps, histograms, 
density plots) based on the final data sets (s08). It creates visual summaries of study 
participants, study locations, vaccination dates, immunogenicity measurements, and additional maps 
for selected pathogens.

Functions Used:
- `fun_breaks.R`: Function to set nice upper, middle, and lower breaks in ggplot.
- `fun_limits.R`: Function to set nice upper, and lower limits in ggplot.

Outputs:
Saved in the /figures directory:
- `data_raw_individuals.pdf` Participant information ("Who?")
- `data_raw_map.pdf` Locations of randomized controlled trials ("Where?")
- `data_raw_vaccinations.pdf` Dates when vaccinations were administered ("When?")
- `data_raw_immunogenicity_time.pdf` Time interval between the last vaccination and immunogenicity 
   measurement ("When AB?")
- `data_raw_immunogenicity.pdf` Immunogenicity measurements after vaccination ("What?")

For each selected pathogen (14 in total):
- `map_reg_6_{i}.pdf` Maps showing RCT locations for each pathogen.

Additionally, a combined figure for the manuscript is saved as:
- `fig1.pdf`
####################################################################################################

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
source("fun_figures/fun_breaks.R")
source("fun_figures/fun_limits.R")
source("fun_figures/fun_figures.R")
library(colorspace)
theme_set(theme_classic())

fun_lablon <- function(x) ifelse(x < 0, paste0(abs(x), "°W"), ifelse(x > 0, paste0(x, "°E"), "0°"))
fun_lablat <- function(x) ifelse(x < 0, paste0(abs(x), "°S"), ifelse(x > 0, paste0(x, "°N"), "0°"))
```

# Read in the data (only s08 data)
```{r}
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v3)_s08.*", "\\1", 
                    str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE))

dat_l$dipht %>%
  filter(str_detect(vac_name_conco_v1, "strep|men")) %>%
  distinct(study)
```

# Summary Statistics: Basic checks on participants, studies, and countries
```{r}
# Check 96 studies and 46512 participants
length(unique(bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat")$pid))
length(unique(bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat")$study))
# Number of countries
length(unique(bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat")$country))
# Summary 
select(bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat"), country, age, vac_date_v1, lat_med, lon_med, time_v1_v2, 
       time_v2_v3, time_vl_s1) %>%
  summary()

tbl_tot <- bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat") %>%
  group_by(pat, imm_sero_s1, imm_met_s1) %>%
  summarise(tot_study = n_distinct(study), tot = n())

tbl_stu <- bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat") %>%
  group_by(pat, imm_sero_s1, imm_met_s1, study) %>%
  summarise(tot_study = n_distinct(study), tot = n())

write.table(tbl_tot, "tables/tbl_tot_final.txt")
write.table(tbl_stu, "tables/tbl_studies_final.txt")
# CONSIDERING OPV MENY STREP MULTIES 11 AND 13
```

# Figure 1 =========================================================================================

# Figure 1a ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare data for the plot 
```{r}
# Define selected pathogens for the manuscript figure
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1",
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")

fig1_l <- list()

# Prepare data for Figure 1a: Combine participant data for the selected pathogens and 
# merge with tidy pathogen names.
fig1_l$dfa <- bind_rows(lapply(dat_l[pat_sel], distinct, study, pid, sex, age), .id = "pat") %>%
  # Add tidy names for the pathogens 
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat))
```

# Figure 1a Plots: Participants, Age, and Sex Ratio
```{r}
## Figure 1a.1: Histogram showing the number of participants per study for each pathogen
fig1_l$fa1 <- fun_figpar(fig1_l$dfa) 
## Figure 1a.2: Plot showing age at first vaccination (in months) by pathogen
fig1_l$fa2  <- fun_figage(fig1_l$dfa)
## Figure 1a.3: Stacked bar plot showing the sex ratio by pathogen
fig1_l$fa3 <- fun_figsex(fig1_l$dfa)
## Patch plots together 
fig1_l$fa <- fig1_l$fa1 + fig1_l$fa2 + fig1_l$fa3 + plot_layout(widths = c(3,4,0.5))
```

# Figure 1b: Maps and additional density plots for selected pathogen -------------------------------

# Prepare data for the plot 
```{r}
## Read in world map 
## Read in world map data (polygon outlines for country boundaries)
world <- map_data("world") 

## Prepare data for two groups of selected pathogens, merging tidy names and 
## standardizing country names (e.g., "United States" to "USA")
fig1_l$dfb <- bind_rows(dat_l[pat_sel], .id = "pat") %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  mutate(country = case_when(country == "United States" ~ "USA", .default = country),
         col_g = if_else(pat %in% pat_sel[1:7], "1", "2")) %>%
  group_split(col_g)

## Aggregate location data across all selected pathogens for plotting purposes
fig1_l$dfb_agg <- bind_rows(lapply(dat_l[pat_sel], function(x) {
  distinct(x, pid, country, reg_6, lat_med, lon_med) %>%
    group_by(country, reg_6) %>%
    summarise(tot = n(),
              lat_med = mean(lat_med),
              lon_med = mean(lon_med), 
              .groups = "drop")
  }), .id = "pathogen") %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove_all(reg_6, " ")) %>%
  # Add tidy names for the pathogens 
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, join_by(pathogen == pat)) %>%
  # Add tidy clu
  left_join(tidy_names_clu, by = join_by(clu)) %>%
  # Rename countries to match world map
  mutate(country = case_when(country == "United States" ~ "USA", .default = country))
```

# Figure 1b 
```{r}
## Figure 1b.1: Time-series plots of vaccination weeks per region
fig1_l$fb1 <- lapply(fig1_l$dfb, fun_figvacc)
# Figure 1b.2: Density plots of immunogenicity results per region
fig1_l$fb2 <- lapply(fig1_l$dfb, fun_figimm)
# Figure 1b.3: Maps of study locations for each subgroup of pathogens
fig1_l$fb3 <- lapply(fig1_l$dfb, fun_figmap, x_agg = fig1_l$dfb_agg)
# Extract legend
fig1_l$fb_leg <- cowplot::get_plot_component(fig1_l$fb3[[1]], "guide-box", return_all = TRUE)[[4]]
## Patch plots together 
fig1_l$fb <- fig1_l$fb1[[1]] + fig1_l$fb2[[1]] + (fig1_l$fb3[[1]] + theme(legend.position = "none")) + 
             fig1_l$fb1[[2]] + fig1_l$fb2[[2]] + (fig1_l$fb3[[2]] + theme(legend.position = "none")) + 
             plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(0.75, 0.75, 2, 0.75, 0.75, 2))
```

# Figure 1 
```{r}
## Patch plots together 
fig1_l$fg <- free(fig1_l$fa) + fig1_l$fb_leg + fig1_l$fb + plot_layout(nrow = 3, heights  = c(1.5,0.2,2))
# Save the plot 
ggsave(glue("{dirs$figures}/fig1.pdf"), fig1_l$fg, width = 10.1, height = 11.2)
```

# Supplementar figure 2: Week of vaccination =======================================================
```{r}
figsup2_l <- list()
figsup2_l$df <- bind_rows(lapply(dat_l[pat_sel], distinct, study, pid, vac_week_v1, reg_6), .id = "pat") %>%
  # Add tidy names for the pathogens 
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove_all(reg_6, " ")) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu, by = join_by(clu)) %>%
  group_by(pat, reg_6)

figsup2_l$fg <- figsup2_l$df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, fill = clu_tidy)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 52) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "mako", begin = 0.2, end = 0.8) +
  facet_nested_wrap(pat_tidy+clu_tidy~., scales = "free_y", ncol = 5, nest_line = TRUE, solo_line = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous("Individuals vaccinated", expand = c(0,0), breaks = fun_breaks,
                     limits = fun_limits) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Latitudinal classification", nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, 
                             keyheight = unit(8, "pt"))) + 
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.background = element_blank())
figsup2_l$fg

# Save the plot 
ggsave(plot = figsup2_l$fg, glue("{dirs$figures}/figsup2.pdf"), width = 7, height = 10)
```

# Read in the data (only s08 data)
```{r}
datsemeth_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
  list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"), "semeth"), "vzv|multi|meny", 
  negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(datsemeth_l) <- sub(
  ".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v2|v3)_s08.*", "\\1", str_subset(str_subset(str_subset(
  list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"), "semeth"), "vzv|multi|meny", negate = TRUE))

bind_rows(datsemeth_l, .id = "pat") %>%
  group_by(pat, imm_sero_s1, imm_met_s1) %>%
  summarise(tot_study = n_distinct(study), tot = n())
```

# Prepare the data 
```{r}
# Identify semeth methods
pat_meth <- lapply(datsemeth_l, bind_rows, .id = "pat") %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "dat") %>%
  distinct(dat, pat, imm_met_s1) %>%
  mutate(imm_met_s1_tidy = toupper(imm_met_s1))

# Prepare data for Figure 
figsup8_l <- list()
figsup8_l$dfa <- bind_rows(lapply(datsemeth_l, distinct, study, pid, sex, age, imm_met_s1), .id = "pat") %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_pat, by = join_by(pat)) %>%
  mutate(imm_met_s1_tidy = toupper(imm_met_s1)) %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = factor(paste0(pat_tidy, " (", imm_met_s1_tidy, ")"), levels = c(
    "Diphteria (PRNT)", "Mumps (PRNT)", "VZV (ELISA)", "N. men A (BAC)", "N. men C (BAC)", "S. pn 01 (OPA)",
    "S. pn 03 (OPA)", "S. pn 04 (OPA)", "S. pn 05 (OPA)", "S. pn 06a (OPA)", "S. pn 06b (OPA)",
    "S. pn 07f (OPA)", "S. pn 09v (OPA)", "S. pn 14 (OPA)", "S. pn 18c (OPA)", "S. pn 19a (OPA)",
    "S. pn 19f (OPA)", "S. pn 23f (OPA)")))
```

# Other plots ======================================================================================

# Seropositive
```{r}
bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat") %>%
  filter(str_detect(pat, "multi", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(pat, imm_spos_s1) %>%
  summarise(count_spos = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(count_tot = sum(count_spos)) %>%
  mutate(per = round(count_spos/count_tot*100, digits = 3) )%>%
  filter(imm_spos_s1 == 1) %>%
  arrange(per)
  
bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat") %>%
  filter(str_detect(pat, "multi", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(pat, reg_6, imm_spos_s1) %>%
  summarise(count_spos = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(pat, reg_6) %>%
  mutate(count_tot = sum(count_spos)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = count_spos/count_tot, y = reg_6, fill = as.character(imm_spos_s1))) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_discrete_sequential(name = "Seropositive", palette = "BluGrn") + 
  facet_wrap(~pat) + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank())
```

# Time frames per pathogen
```{r}
bind_rows(dat_l, .id = "pat") %>%
  filter(str_detect(pat, "multi|opv", negate = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  summarise(year_min = min(year(vac_date_v1)),
            year_max = max(year(vac_date_v1))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = pat, x = year_min)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(1998, 2018), color = "grey") + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_point(aes(x = year_max)) + 
  geom_segment(aes(x = year_min, xend = year_max)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1998:2018)
```
